description: Turn the client's brand report on or off, make it weekly or monthly, or change who it's for (their email, and a first name for the greeting) or the local hour it's ready. Partial: what you leave out stays. Turning it on sends nothing by itself; the team is told when each report is ready.

hour.description: Local hour the report is ready (default 9)

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

name.description: Their first name for the greeting; default from the email

to.description: The client's email; null clears it

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: report_schedule_set
title: Change the client report schedule
